svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — Recipe cards (21)
svg.desc: Every possible 5-of-7 recipe, exactly once — 21 cards, 64x38 mm. Deal two to each captain, keep one, as the app does. Units: mm. 25 mm squares, 5.9 mm material. KERF-COMPENSATED: cut lines offset 0.1375 mm away from the kept wood (kerf 0.275 mm) — cut exactly on the line. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
